title: BoardroomAI: Dependency-Aware Human-Steerable Multi-Agent Deliberation through Evolving Decision Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2608.13046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organizational decisions are co-created while evidence, constraints, and human priorities continue to evolve. In conventional transcript-based multi-agent systems, humans typically provide an initial problem, agents deliberate internally, and the system returns a final response. BoardroomAI instead treats the human as a persistent participant who can intervene by challenging assumptions, modifying constraints, changing priorities, introducing evidence, or redirecting the decision process. translated_title: BoardroomAI：通过演化决策图实现依赖感知且可人工干预的多智能体审议
translated_abstract: 组织决策是共同创造的，同时证据、约束条件和人类优先级持续演化。在传统的基于转录的多智能体系统中，人类通常提供初始问题，智能体在内部进行审议，系统最终返回一个最终响应。BoardroomAI则将人类视为持续参与者，能够通过质疑假设、修改约束、改变优先级、引入证据或重新引导决策过程来进行干预。我们通过四个组件实现了这种人机共存：(i) 一个类型化决策图，表示证据、假设、约束、主张、反对意见、备选方案、风险、决策、语义依赖和专家责任；(ii) 一个干预编译器，将确认的人类行动转换为明确的图更新；(iii) 依赖感知传播，识别受影响的子图，保留未受影响的构件，以及(iv) 一个可演化的决策图，支持持续审议和透明追踪。
tldr: BoardroomAI提出了一种依赖感知且可人工干预的多智能体决策框架，通过演化决策图支持人类持续参与和动态调整，显著提升了决策过程的透明性和适应性。
en_tdlr: BoardroomAI introduces a dependency-aware, human-steerable multi-agent deliberation framework using evolving decision graphs, enabling persistent human intervention and dynamic adaptation for transparent and adaptive organizational decision-making.
